summary: The document is a fact sheet titled 'Infosys Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026,' presenting financial metrics and growth data for Infosys. It includes revenue growth percentages for Q3 2026, segmented by business areas such as Financial Services, Manufacturing, and others, as well as by geographic regions like North America and Europe. The sheet details quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) and year-over-year (YoY) growth rates, highlighting a 0.6% QoQ and 1.7% YoY growth in constant currency. It also provides client data, including the number of active clients and million-dollar clients, with specific figures for top client contributions to revenues. Notable insights include a reported 18.4% operating margin and a 6.6% reported YTD EPS increase.
